digest.component_or_area: rebar link command and caused_by relation validation
propositions: caused_by links accept any target without validation, allowing misattributed edges whose targets have no referencing commits
The referencing-commit scan exists only in close_precheck._referencing_commits and conflates 'no commits found' with 'git history unreadable'
A new predicate must refuse caused_by links to targets without >=1 referencing commit, blocking both link_core and _link_dry_run consistently
The --force=[reason] escape hatch on CLI, library, and MCP must allow forced caused_by links when commit verification cannot proceed or is intentionally overridden
Inbound reconciliation must pass force="inbound reconcile: peer-authored edge" to bypass refusal for peer-authored caused_by edges
Documentation and SKILL examples must clarify that caused_by validation gates the CLI/library/MCP forms only, not the close gate's --caused-by flag
